title: Personal Resume Website
summary: Designed and maintain a custom, data-driven résumé website built with Hugo, supported by an automated deployment pipeline and Cloudflare infrastructure.
highlights: Customized the Hugo Resume theme through local layouts, partials, shortcodes, and CSS overrides while keeping the upstream theme isolated as a Git submodule.
Structured résumé content in JSON and built Hugo templates to render employment history, technical skills, education, languages, and credentials.
Implemented a GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow with change detection, a pinned Hugo Extended build, caching, and automated deployment to Cloudflare Pages using Wrangler.
Developed a Cloudflare Pages Worker that serves PDF documents stored as GitHub Release assets through stable URLs on the portfolio domain and forwards other requests to the site's static assets.
Self-hosted the site's CSS, JavaScript, and fonts; combined stylesheets with Hugo Pipes, minification, and fingerprinting for cache-friendly asset delivery.
